import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 4 input']; O=G['Demo pair 4 output']
br=sorted({(r,c) for r in range(30) for c in range(10) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]})
print(br)
# left rail rows1-13 (col0); right rail col9 rows17-29. Right beam rows abs: 
rows={r for r,c in br}
print('right-beam rows:', sorted(rows))

def load():

def f(g, seed_emit_dirs=(0,1,2,3), rail_emit_all=True):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=components(g,bg)
    DIRS=[(-1,0),(0,-1),(0,1),(1,0)]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # seed rays toward nearest rail only; direction determined by ray that reaches a rail
    seeds=[(v[0][0],v[0][1],k) for k,(cc,cells) in enumerate(cs) if len(cells)==1]
    seeds_ok=[]
    for sr,sc,ci in seeds:
        best=None
        for di,cells in cs:
            if len(cells)!=1: continue
            d=min(abs(a-sr)+abs(b-sc) for a,b in cells)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,di,cells)
        _,di,cells=best
        vert = cells[0][1]==cells[-1][1]
        base=min(a for a,b in cells) if vert else min(b for a,b in cells)
        if vert: off=sr-base; dirper=(0,1)
        else: off=sc-base; dirper=(1,0)
        cp=min(cells,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-sr)+abs(p[1]-sc))
        dr=(cp[0]>sr)-(cp[0]<sr); dc=(cp[1]>sc)-(cp[1]<sc)
        r0,c0=sr+dr,sc+dc
        while 0<=r0<H and 0<=c0<W and out[r0][c0]==bg:
            out[r0][c0]=7; r0+=dr; c0+=dc
        seeds_ok.append((sr,sc))
    # paint seeds as 4 last
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=components(g,bg)
    singles=[(cc,cl[0]) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)==1]
    rails=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # seed rays toward nearest rail
    for cc,(sr,sc) in singles:
        best=None
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            r0,c0=sr+dr,sc+dc
            # does ray reach a rail cell?
            while 0<=r0<H and 0<=c0<W:
                if any((r0,c0) in cl for _,cl in rails):
                    dist=(abs(sr-r0)+abs(sc-c0)) if False else None
                    if best is None or abs(r0-sr)+abs(c0-sc)<best[0]:
                        best=(abs(r0-sr)+abs(c0-sc),dr,dc)
                r0+=dr;c0+=dc
        if best:
            _,dr,dc=best
            r0,c0=sr+dr,sc+dc
            while 0<=r0<H and 0<=c0<W and out[r0][c0]==bg:
                out[r0][c0]=cc; r0+=dr;c0+=dc
        out[sr][sc]=4
    return out

# Hypothesis: interior fill. Flood fill from OUTSIDE background cells. Enclosed bg cells -> seed color. Walls don't emit.
def solve_fill(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g)
    seeds=[cl[0] for col,cl in cc if len(cl)==1 and col!=bgc]
    secol=g[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]] if seeds else None
    # outside flood
    outside=set()
    st=[(0,c) for c in range(W) if g[0][c]==bgc]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in st: seen[r][c]=True
    q=[list(st)]; 
    while q:
        r,c=q.pop()
        if (r,c) in outside: continue
        outside.add((r,c))
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nx,ny=r+dx,c+dy
            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]==bgc:
                seen[nx][ny]=True; q.append([nx,ny])
    # careful: seen marked initially for row0 only; redo cleanly
    outside=set(); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    qq=[(0,c) for c in range(W) if g[0][c]==bgc]
    for r,c in qq: seen[r][c]=True; outside.add((r,c))
    while qq:
        r,c=qq.pop()
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nx,ny=r+dx,c+dy
            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]==bgc:
                seen[nx][ny]=True; outside.add((nx,ny)); qq.append((nx,ny))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==bgc and (r,c) not in outside:
                out[r][c]=secol
    for s in seeds: out[s[0]][s[1]]=4
    return out
tot=0

    o=solve_fill(gi)

    tot+=bad
    print(i,bad,'of',len(go)*len(go[0]))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g)
    seeds=[cl[0] for col,cl in cc if len(cl)==1 and col!=bgc]
    secol=g[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]] if seeds else None
    # walls: components with >1 cell. classify by bounding box orientation
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def beam(r,c,dr,dc):
        while True:
            r+=dr;c+=dc
            if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==bgc: out[r][c]=secol; continue
            break
    # endpoints of multi-cell comps emit along BOTH axes? try: perpendicular-to-long-axis beams from each END
    for col,cl in cc:
        if len(cl)<2: continue
        horiz = len({r for r,c2 in cl})==1
        ends=set()
        for p in cl:
            nb=[q for q in cl if abs(q[0]-p[0])+abs(q[1]-p[1])==1]
            if len(nb)==1: ends.add(p)
        ds=((1,0),(-1,0)) if horiz else ((0,1),(0,-1))
        for e in ends:
            for dr,dc in ds: beam(e[0],e[1],dr,dc)
    for s in seeds: out[s[0]][s[1]]=4
    return out
tot=[]
for i in range(1,9):

    o=solve(gi)
    bad=sum(1 for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if o[r][c]!=go[r][c])
    tot.append(bad)
print(tot, sum(tot))

import json
gi=G['Test input']
out=[row[:] for row in gi]
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
seeds=[(10,13),(11,8),(12,9),(13,8),(14,18)]
# all four directions from each seed
def beam(r,c,dr,dc):
    while True:
        r+=dr;c+=dc
        if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
        if gi[r][c]==5: out[r][c]=2
        else: break
for sr,sc in seeds:
    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): beam(sr,sc,dr,dc)
for s in seeds: out[s[0]][s[1]]=4
for r in range(H):
    print(''.join('.' if x==5 else str(x) for x in out[r]))
print(json.dumps(out))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g)
    seeds=[cl[0] for col,cl in cc if len(cl)==1 and col!=bgc]
    secol=g[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]] if seeds else None
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def beam(r,c,dr,dc):
        while True:
            r+=dr;c+=dc
            if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==bgc: out[r][c]=secol; continue
            break
    # multi-cell comps emit from each end ALONG their axis (both dirs) — plus perpendicular? try all dirs along axis only
    for col,cl in cc:
        if len(cl)<2: continue
        horiz = len({r for r,c2 in cl})==1
        ends=set()
        for p in cl:
            nb=[q for q in cl if abs(q[0]-p[0])+abs(q[1]-p[1])==1]
            if len(nb)==1: ends.add(p)
        ds=((1,0),(-1,0)) if horiz else ((0,1),(0,-1))
        for e in ends:
            for dr,dc in ds: beam(e[0],e[1],dr,dc)
    for s in seeds: out[s[0]][s[1]]=4
    return out
tot=[]
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    o=solve(gi)
    bad=sum(1 for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if o[r][c]!=go[r][c])
    tot.append(bad)
print(tot,sum(tot))

# Unified model so far: bars emit beams perpendicular to their axis, only from endpoint cells,
# direction toward nearest wall; seed sits ON a beam path (seed color = paint color); seed -> 4.
# Verify this hypothesis on all demos with a clean implementation, checking beam termination and wall choice.
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # components 4-connected by same color
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r_ in range(H):
        for c_ in range(W):
            if seen[r_][c_]: continue
            st=[(r_,c_)]; seen[r_][c_]=True; cl=[]
            while st:
                p=st.pop(); cl.append(p)
                for dr_,dc_ in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    rr_,cc_=p[0]+dr_,p[1]+dc_
                    if 0<=rr_<H and 0<=cc_<W and not seen[rr_][cc_] and g[rr_][cc_]==g[r_][c_]:
                        seen[rr_][cc_]=True; st.append((rr_,cc_))
            res.append((g[r_][c_],cl))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for v,cl in res:
        if len(cl)<3:  # seed -> 4, nothing else
            out[cl[0][0]][cl[0][1]]=4; continue
        pts=set(cl)
        nb=lambda p:[q for q in pts if abs(q[0]-p[0])+abs(q[1]-p[1])==1]
        eps=[p for p in pts if len(nb(p))<=1]  # endpoints + isolated singletons of the bar color
        horiz=len({r_ for r_,c_ in cl})==1
        perp=((0,1),(0,-1)) if horiz else ((1,0),(-1,0))
        for p in eps:
            for dr_,dc_ in perp:
                # direction toward nearest wall: count steps to edge in both dirs, pick shorter total? 
                r_,c_=p
                d1=(H-r_-1)*max(0,1)+ (c_)*(1 if dc_>0 else -1)  # placeholder
                dist_a=sum(max(0,1-abs(r_))) 
        # choose dir with fewer cells to edge before leaving grid
        def nd(p,dr_,dc_):
            r_,c_=p
            n=0
            while True:
                n+=1; r_+=dr_; c_+=dc_
                if not(0<=r_<H and 0<=c_<W): return n
        for p in eps:
            for dr_,dc_ in perp:
                d=nd(p,dr_,dc_)
                if d<=max(H,W)-d: pass
                emit(out,p,dr_,dc_)
    return out
def emit(out,p,dr,dc,bg=None):
    H,W=len(out),len(out[0])
    r,c=p
    while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r][c]==bg_:
        out[r][c]=paint; r+=dr; c+=dc

def bars_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r_ in range(H):
        for c_ in range(W):
            if seen[r_][c_]: continue
            st=[(r_,c_)]; seen[r_][c_]=True; cl=[]
            while st:
                p=st.pop(); cl.append(p)
                for dr_,dc_ in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    rr_,cc_=p[0]+dr_,p[1]+dc_
                    if 0<=rr_<H and 0<=cc_<W and not seen[rr_][cc_] and g[rr_][cc_]==g[r_][c_]:
                        seen[rr_][cc_]=True; st.append((rr_,cc_))
            res.append((g[r_][c_],cl))
    return bgc,res
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc,objs=bars_of(g)
    seeds=[cl[0] for v,cl in objs if len(cl)==1]
    bars=[cl for v,cl in objs if len(cl)>=3]
    # identify seed color and bar color(s)
    seedcol=g[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]]
    assert len(seeds)>0
    # vertical bars: each is a column segment
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for s in seeds:
        out[s[0]][s[1]]=4
    for b in bars:
        pts=set(b)
        vert=len({c_ for r_,c_ in b})==1
        rows_=sorted(r_ for r_,c_ in b); cols_=sorted(c_ for r_,c_ in b)
        if vert:
            col=cols_[0]; r0,r1=rows_[0],rows_[-1]
            # seeds whose row is within [r0,r1] and on one side of the bar -> beam toward bar, colored seedcol
            sr=[s for s in seeds if r0<=s[0]<=r1]
            for s in sr:
                d = 1 if s[1]<col else -1
                r=s[0]; c=s[1]+d
                while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r][c]==bgc:
                    out[r][c]=seedcol; c+=d
        else:
            row=rows_[0]; c0,c1=cols_[0],cols_[-1]
            sc=[s for s in seeds if c0<=s[1]<=c1]
            for s in sc:
                d = 1 if s[0]<row else -1
                r=s[0]+d; c=s[1]
                while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r][c]==bgc:
                    out[r][c]=seedcol; r+=d
    return out

def comps(g,color):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in g]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==color and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True;cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==color and not seen[x][y]:
                                seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    bars=comps(g,5); seeds=comps(g,2)
    b=bars[0]
    rs=[r for r,c in b]; cs=[c for r,c in b]
    vert = len(set(rs))==1 or (max(rs)-min(rs)+1)<(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
    # bar axis: the longer dimension of its bbox? use: vertical if column range smaller
    v = (max(cs)-min(cs)+1) < (max(rs)-min(rs)+1)
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    near=min(bars,key=lambda z:min(abs(max(p[0] if v else p[1] for p in z)-q) for q in [b[0]]))  # placeholder
    for s in seeds:
        r,c=s[0]
        # beam toward bar: direction along bar axis
        step=(1 if v else 1)
        dr=1 if v else 0
        dc=0 if v else 1
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=5:
            g[rr][cc]=s
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
